title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 022
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute chat and comment variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded chat bubble outline with two short text bars and a lower tail
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a speech bubble that visibly contains short text bars.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for dot or empty bubbles when the two inner text bars need to be shown.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows one rounded speech bubble with two stacked inner text bars.

items.depicts_observation: Round chat bubble outline with two centered dots and a lower left tail
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a conversation bubble that reads as two message dots.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for text bar or empty bubbles when the two centered dots are visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces text bars with two centered dots inside a round bubble.

items.depicts_observation: Round empty chat bubble outline with a short lower left tail
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the most minimal round speech bubble without inner marks.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for dotted or text bar bubbles when the center should stay empty.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a plain round bubble with no interior dots or bars at all.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded square chat bubble with two short vertical marks inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a softer square bubble instead of a round speech balloon.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for round bubbles when the rounded square body and short vertical marks matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot changes the bubble body into a rounded square with two vertical inner marks.

items.depicts_observation: Two overlapping comment bubble outlines with one front tail and one rear tail
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants to show multiple comment bubbles rather than one single chat balloon.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for single bubble icons when the two overlapping bubble outlines matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a pair of overlapping comment bubbles instead of one standalone bubble.
